audit_label: PT0 — GitHub Actions dashboard for microsoft/vscode (WebFetch DOM-fallback)

evidence_mode.limitations: WebFetch returns partial static HTML; the Actions dashboard requires JavaScript rendering for full DOM. CVD simulator unavailable on this rig (Windows 11 / no live browser session). All color values sourced from Primer design-system token files (github.com/primer/primitives main branch, fetched 2026-06-02) and GitHub REST API run data. No sRGB-linearization check performed. No physiological CVD model applied. All findings are Inferred; none are Observed or BLOCK.

context.task: Monitor CI status for a large open-source repository; triage pass/fail runs before merging a pull request
context.dense_state: 2,500+ workflow runs visible with conclusion values including success, failure, skipped, cancelled, and action_required (confirmed via GitHub REST API); filter controls in error/loading state; in-progress runs present
context.viewport_render_limitation: No live browser render available on this rig. The WebFetch tool returns partial static HTML only. JavaScript-rendered components (status icons, animated spinners, chart visualizations, filter dropdowns) were not rendered. Color values and component patterns were sourced from the Primer design-system token source (github.com/primer/primitives) and GitHub Octicons icon library as named inference-chain evidence. This is the strongest available Inferred evidence on this rig, but is weaker than live observation with a qualified CVD simulator.
context.simulation_tool: none — no CVD simulator was run

color_only_conveyance.notes: One Critical (CD-01: success/failure distinguished by red/green hue without persistent text label) produces a section Fail. CD-02 (High: skipped/cancelled states require shape-memory without text) and CD-03 (High: Contrast-Pass / Hue-Fail boundary case documented by Primer CVD overrides) contribute additional severity. Two Highs + one Critical = Fail.

chart_graph_encoding.notes: Run-list duration data is text-only (CVD-safe). Run-detail visualization graph not rendered by WebFetch; OQ-01 logs the open question. No rainbow/jet or red-green diverging colormap detected on the surface audited. CD-04 is Medium. Section Warns on the open question about the visualization graph.

form_validation.notes: Filter controls in error state confirmed by WebFetch ('Sorry, something went wrong'). Inline error text is present (partial mitigation). Whether border-only color change occurs as a secondary signal is unconfirmed (OQ-02). CD-05 is High; one High is below the 3-High section-Fail threshold, so section Warns.

mode_state_indication.notes: Two Medium findings (CD-06: active tab/sidebar state; CD-07: in-progress spinner under reduced-motion). Primer ActionList uses CheckIcon for selection (positive). No Critical or High findings confirmed; section Warns on open questions about sidebar active state.

cvd_simulation.notes: Methods gate: no qualified CVD simulator was run on this rig. CD-08 is Medium (methods gate not passed). All other findings are Inferred pending a qualified PT1 run. Section Warns because the gate is documentably unresolvable on this rig — the gap has a concrete resolution path (DaltonLens on a live browser session).

configuration_cost.notes: CD-09 (High): CVD-safe theme exists but requires 3+ clicks from the working surface. CD-10 (Medium, Open question): theme selection UI may use color-only selected-state indicator. One High is below section-Fail threshold; section Warns. Positive: the CVD theme is a genuine fix, not a re-skin.

evidence.notes: Run executed against the realistic dense-state surface (2,500+ runs confirmed via GitHub API; mixed conclusions confirmed). Meaningful state documented per finding. No CVD simulator run — all findings Inferred. No finding marked BLOCK (two-tier rule honored). Tool: none (DOM-fallback). CVD classes tested: none. Section Warns because the process gate is partially satisfied (correct state, correct inference chain, correct labeling) but the simulator gap is unresolved.

findings.title: Workflow run success/failure status distinguished primarily by red/green hue
findings.surface: Workflow run list — status icon column
findings.evidence_summary: Primer fgColor.success = green.5 (#2da44e) and fgColor.danger = #d1242f are the status icon colors in default light theme. No persistent text label ('Success'/'Failure') confirmed visible in run list rows. GitHub API confirms mixed success/failure runs exist.

findings.title: Skipped and cancelled run states lack robust non-color differentiation from success
findings.surface: Workflow run list — status icon, skipped and cancelled conclusions
findings.evidence_summary: GitHub API confirmed conclusion values include 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'action_required' alongside 'success' and 'failure'. Primer fgColor.muted (gray) applies to neutral states. Icon shapes exist (skip-fill, circle-slash) but no text labels confirmed persistent.

findings.title: Default theme red/green pair lies on the deuteranomaly confusion line (Contrast-Pass / Hue-Fail)
findings.surface: Any surface using fgColor.success + fgColor.danger in the default light/dark themes
findings.evidence_summary: Primer token source confirms fgColor.success (green.5 #2da44e) and fgColor.danger (#d1242f) are the default status colors. Primer's own CVD overrides replace these with blue/orange for the 'light-protanopia-deuteranopia' theme — direct evidence that the engineers identified the red/green pair as a CVD failure.

findings.title: Timing duration data is text-only on the run list; run-detail chart encoding is unconfirmed
findings.surface: Workflow run list — duration column; run-detail visualization graph (unrendered)
findings.evidence_summary: WebFetch confirmed durations as text ('8m 14s', '30m 37s', '2s'). Run-detail visualization graph not rendered. GitHub docs confirm 'An icon to the left of the job name indicates the status' — icon-based, not chart-based, on detail page.

findings.title: Filter dropdown error state uses color-only danger signaling (inferred from Primer form patterns)
findings.evidence_summary: WebFetch returned filter controls in error state with text 'Sorry, something went wrong'. Primer bgColor.danger.muted (red background) and fgColor.danger (red text) apply to form error states. Inline error text is a partial non-color cue; border-color change as sole signal is unconfirmed.

findings.title: Active workflow tab indicator relies on color-accent underline; sidebar active item may be fill-only
findings.surface: Left sidebar — active workflow selector; repository tab row
findings.evidence_summary: Primer tab component uses 2px underline (non-color cue present). ActionList Selection.tsx confirmed to use CheckIcon. Active sidebar background fill color (fgColor.accent.muted = light blue) may be the sole differentiator if CheckIcon is not present.

findings.title: In-progress spinner is motion-only under reduced-motion; static color dot remains
findings.surface: Workflow run list — active/running run indicators
findings.evidence_summary: WebFetch confirmed 'In progress' text label present for running workflows. Under prefers-reduced-motion, the spinner animation is suppressed. Primer fgColor.attention = yellow.5 (#d4a72c) applies to in-progress state — not on red/green confusion axis but may be confused under tritanomaly.

findings.title: No qualified CVD simulator was available on this rig (methods gate not passed)
findings.evidence_summary: Rig constraint: Windows 11 / no live browser session. No Machado-model simulator run. sRGB linearization not verified. All four CVD classes untested. Findings are Inferred, not Observed.

findings.title: CVD-safe theme requires 3+ clicks from the Actions dashboard and is not discoverable from the failure state
findings.evidence_summary: Primer token source confirms 'light-protanopia-deuteranopia' theme exists with blue/orange override for success/danger. Navigation path: avatar menu → Settings → Appearance (3 clicks minimum). No in-flow accessibility hint on the Actions dashboard.

findings.title: Theme selection UI uses color swatches; currently selected theme indicator may be color-dependent
findings.surface: GitHub Settings > Appearance — theme selection grid
findings.evidence_summary: Appearance settings page not rendered by WebFetch (529 errors). Primer ActionList uses CheckIcon for selection (non-color cue). Whether the theme grid uses ActionList or a custom thumbnail-radio pattern is unknown.

open_questions.summary: Does the run-detail visualization graph use multi-color encoding for parallel jobs, or a single hue?
open_questions.resolution_path: Navigate to a multi-job run detail page (e.g. a run with 10+ parallel jobs). Apply CVD simulation to confirm whether job colors survive deutan/protan simulation.

open_questions.summary: Do the filter dropdown controls use a colored border change (without accompanying text) as their primary error signal when loading fails?
open_questions.resolution_path: Live navigation to the Actions page with simulated slow network or forced error state; observe whether border color change is sole or primary visual error cue.

open_questions.summary: Does the left-sidebar active workflow selection rely on background fill color alone, or does it also use a border or icon cue?
open_questions.resolution_path: Live DevTools inspection of sidebar computed styles on active vs inactive workflow list items.

open_questions.summary: What are the exact hex values and luminance ratios of success/failure status icons in the rendered page (not from design tokens)?
open_questions.resolution_path: Run DevTools computed-style inspection on a rendered success and failure icon element; extract actual rendered color and compute luminance ratio against background.

open_questions.summary: Does the GitHub Appearance settings page indicate the currently selected theme with a shape/icon cue or only with a color border?
open_questions.resolution_path: Live navigation to github.com/settings/appearance with DaltonLens deuteranopia simulation active.

positive_observations.summary: Primer's light-protanopia-deuteranopia theme correctly swaps success (green→blue) and danger (red→orange) — a genuine fix direction, not a re-skin. The accommodation exists and was clearly intentionally designed.
The 'In progress' text label is visible for running workflows in the run list — the most actionable current state has a text label alongside its icon.
Primer's ActionList component uses CheckIcon (shape-based cue) for selected items. If the workflow sidebar uses ActionList, the active selection cue includes a non-color indicator.
Duration data in the run list is displayed as plain text ('8m 14s'), not as color-encoded bars. Text durations are inherently CVD-safe.

exit_criteria_check.contrast_pass_hue_fail_note: CD-01 and CD-03 both document the Contrast-Pass / Hue-Fail boundary: green.5 (#2da44e) and danger red (#d1242f) pass WCAG 1.4.3 luminance against white but collapse under deutan/protan simulation. CD-03 is explicitly labeled as the boundary case. Confirmed by Primer's own CVD theme overrides which exist precisely because these colors collapse.
